name: Secret Hitler
subtitle: Hidden roles, shaky alliances, and one very secret leader.
description: Players are secretly Liberals or Fascists, and one Fascist is Hitler. Each round a President and Chancellor are elected and pass a policy from a rigged deck. Liberals win by passing 5 Liberal policies or assassinating Hitler. Fascists win with 6 Fascist policies or by getting Hitler elected Chancellor late in the game. Based on Secret Hitler by Goat, Wolf & Cabbage (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
